sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def comps(frame, ch):
    p=set()
    for r,row in enumerate(frame.ascii.split('\n')):
        for c in range(len(row)):
            if row[c]==ch and not (r==63 or c==63): p.add((r,c))
    seen=set(); res=[]
    for s in p:
        if s in seen: continue
        stack=[s]; comp=set()
        while stack:
            x=stack.pop()
            if x in comp or x in seen: continue
            comp.add(x); r,c=x
            for d in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(r+d[0],c+d[1])
                if n in p and n not in seen: stack.append(n)
        seen|=comp; res.append(comp)
    return [ (min(r for r,_ in x),max(r for r,_ in x),min(c for _,c in x),max(c for _,c in x),len(x)) for x in res ]
print("before B:", comps(current_frame,'B'))
action(['LEFT'], intent='explore')
print("after B:", comps(current_frame,'B'))
print("res:", last_action_result.get('no_impact'), last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def comps(frame, ch):
    p=set()
    for r,row in enumerate(frame.ascii.split('\n')):
        for c in range(len(row)):
            if row[c]==ch and not (r==63 or c==63): p.add((r,c))
    seen=set(); res=[]
    for s in p:
        if s in seen: continue
        stack=[s]; comp=set()
        while stack:
            x=stack.pop()
            if x in comp or x in seen: continue
            comp.add(x); r,c=x
            for d in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(r+d[0],c+d[1])
                if n in p and n not in seen: stack.append(n)
        seen|=comp; res.append(comp)
    return [ (min(r for r,_ in x),max(r for r,_ in x),min(c for _,c in x),max(c for _,c in x),len(x)) for x in res ]
